biotools.summary: 3DGene is a database and visualization tool that provides predicted 3D conformations of active genes in GM12878 human lymphoblastoid cells, generated using the e-HiP-HoP framework.  The database offers interactive visualizations and downloadable simulation data, revealing insights into gene structure and regulatory networks.
